tools.name: open_editor
tools.description: Open the interactive email editor with the exact working theme, notification, blocks, fields, preview and downloads. All actions retain the connection permissions.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Return the authorized workspace, current theme, accessible themes and granted capabilities. Theme IDs identify the exact target of edits.

tools.name: list_theme_examples
tools.description: Browse and search public Shopemail theme examples that can be copied into an authorized workspace.

tools.name: get_theme_example
tools.description: Read a public example description, structure and appearance before copying it.

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: List owned theme names and immutable IDs within the granted scope. A single-theme grant returns only that theme.

tools.name: get_theme
tools.description: Read the specified authorized theme and its authored appearance, without preview sample values or unrelated themes.

tools.name: list_emails
tools.description: List notification keys and customization summaries for the specified authorized theme.

tools.name: read_email
tools.description: Read authored copy, styles, blocks and rules for the specified theme and notification. Preview sample values are excluded.

tools.name: list_blocks
tools.description: List native and custom block IDs, order, locks, visibility and valid insertion anchors for the specified email.

tools.name: get_email_options
tools.description: Read available copy fields, design choices and data-field eligibility for this email. This tool does not execute edits.

tools.name: list_data_fields
tools.description: List standard notification fields and registered metafield definitions for content or rules. Metafield availability is not verified against Shopify.

tools.name: get_editor_formats
tools.description: Read the actual checked JSON format for variable content, conditions, field references or custom HTML/Liquid.

tools.name: get_block_formats
tools.description: Read supported block types, properties, defaults and limits before constructing a block.

tools.name: list_images
tools.description: List public library images and authorized uploaded images usable in email blocks. Narrow grants reveal only uploads referenced by their theme.

tools.name: get_preview_data
tools.description: Read saved sample data for the authorized workspace or a theme notification. Requires explicitly granted workspace editor access.

tools.name: preview_email
tools.description: Render the actual current email as preview HTML. Uses fictional library samples unless explicit data is supplied or authorized saved samples are requested.

tools.name: inspect_email
tools.description: Compile and inspect the current authored email without saving a change. Return structural checks and a bounded source excerpt.

tools.name: export_email
tools.description: Create an actual short-lived download of the specified current notification as Shopify Liquid or preview HTML. This does not install or send it.

tools.name: export_theme
tools.description: Create an actual ZIP download containing the current theme notification templates, required image copies and installation instructions.

tools.name: get_change_history
tools.description: Read bounded, scoped change summaries for the specified theme. Unrelated theme content and history are excluded.

tools.name: create_custom_theme
tools.description: Create a new theme with the header and essential native Shopify blocks for each notification. Optional blocks can be added back. Use list_blocks to review the notification checklist.

tools.name: copy_theme
tools.description: Create an owned copy of a public theme example or an existing theme in the authorized workspace, with the supplied name.

tools.name: rename_theme
tools.description: Rename the specified owned theme. Its immutable ID and authored content remain the same.

tools.name: archive_theme
tools.description: Archive the specified theme without permanently deleting it. It can be restored.

tools.name: restore_theme
tools.description: Restore an archived theme in the authorized scope.

tools.name: set_workspace_active_theme
tools.description: Set which owned theme is active in the authorized workspace.

tools.name: set_brand_details
tools.description: Update one validated brand profile field shared by the workspace themes.

tools.name: copy_brand_settings
tools.description: Copy supported branding from one authorized owned theme to another authorized theme.

tools.name: set_email_item_layout
tools.description: Configure a notification’s checked order-item cards, static products, scalar product title binding, columns and mobile stacking. Omit binding to restore the original theme layout. Does not change Shopify or confirm installation.

tools.name: set_brand_logo
tools.description: Use an uploaded Shopemail image or an image in the merchant-confirmed Shopify Files folder as the theme’s email header logo. Pass null to restore the theme header.

tools.name: set_theme_font
tools.description: Use a hosted WOFF2 file in the confirmed Shopify Files folder across this theme. Email clients can use the existing font stacks as fallbacks. Pass null to remove the custom font.

tools.name: set_checklist_item
tools.description: Mark a block as required for one email, or remove an additional requirement. Built-in essential requirements are retained. Use list_blocks to see missing, hidden and conditional checklist items.

tools.name: set_brand_color
tools.description: Set a named light or dark color role in the specified theme.

tools.name: set_brand_typography
tools.description: Set a supported typography value in the specified theme.

tools.name: set_brand_shape
tools.description: Set a supported shape value such as corner radius in the specified theme.

tools.name: set_theme_token
tools.description: Set a supported, validated light appearance token in the specified theme.

tools.name: set_dark_theme_token
tools.description: Set a supported, validated dark appearance token in the specified theme.

tools.name: set_theme_layout
tools.description: Set a layout option supported by this theme structure.

tools.name: set_shared_setting
tools.description: Update one validated workspace setting used by its email themes. Merchant-only external URL confirmations remain separate.

tools.name: set_theme_setting
tools.description: Update one supported email setting in the specified theme.

tools.name: set_section_visibility
tools.description: Set the supported visibility state of a native email section.

tools.name: set_section_lock
tools.description: Lock or unlock a native section before a supported removal or visibility change.

tools.name: remove_section
tools.description: Remove an unlocked native section from an email. Validation reports essential information affected by the change.

tools.name: restore_section
tools.description: Restore a previously removed native section in an email.

tools.name: set_email_copy
tools.description: Update a supported literal-copy field in the specified notification and language. Structured variables use set_email_content.

tools.name: set_email_content
tools.description: Set a supported copy field using the checked content/1 text-and-variable format.

tools.name: set_email_style
tools.description: Set one supported appearance override for the specified notification email.

tools.name: set_email_brand_defaults
tools.description: Enable or disable use of the theme brand defaults for the specified notification.

tools.name: set_block_style
tools.description: Set a supported style property on a native block in the specified email.

tools.name: set_native_block_visibility
tools.description: Show or hide a native email block where its locks and validation allow it.

tools.name: set_section_rule
tools.description: Set a checked rule/1 condition controlling a native section in the specified email.

tools.name: remove_section_rule
tools.description: Remove a condition from the specified native email section.

tools.name: set_block_rule
tools.description: Set a checked rule/1 condition controlling the specified custom block.

tools.name: remove_block_rule
tools.description: Remove the condition on the specified custom block.

tools.name: set_block_content
tools.description: Set one supported custom block field using checked content/1 text and variable parts.

tools.name: remove_block_content
tools.description: Remove the structured binding from one custom block field, returning to its literal content.

tools.name: add_data_field
tools.description: Register a labeled scalar order, product or variant metafield definition for reuse in email content and rules. This does not verify its existence in Shopify or fetch live values.

tools.name: remove_data_field
tools.description: Remove a registered metafield from the workspace field catalog. This does not delete data in Shopify.

tools.name: set_preview_data
tools.description: Set validated JSON preview data for the workspace or for one theme notification. These values are samples, not live Shopify data.

tools.name: set_shared_block_content
tools.description: Set a validated shared field used by reusable content blocks across this workspace.

tools.name: reorder_blocks
tools.description: Save the complete ordered list of native and custom block IDs in an email. A changed block list is refused.

tools.name: add_block
tools.description: Add one supported block at a valid insertion anchor. Includes text, images, buttons, reusable content blocks and validated custom HTML/Liquid.

tools.name: update_block
tools.description: Update one validated property of a custom block, including content, layout or visibility.

tools.name: set_custom_code
tools.description: Replace a custom-code block with validated email HTML, supported inline CSS and eligible Shopify Liquid. Scripts and unsupported code are rejected.

tools.name: move_block
tools.description: Move a custom block to a supported native anchor or before another custom block.

tools.name: duplicate_block
tools.description: Create an independent copy of one custom block inside its email.

tools.name: remove_block
tools.description: Remove the specified custom block in one undoable change.

tools.name: studio_snapshot
tools.description: Load the selected theme and its authored emails for the Studio interface.

tools.name: studio_save
tools.description: Save one checked group of changes made through the Studio interface.

tools.name: select_theme
tools.description: Choose an accessible owned theme as this connection’s current context. Subsequent edit calls still name its immutable theme ID explicitly.

tools.name: add_detail_field
tools.description: Add a text block containing a label and a checked field binding at the chosen insertion anchor, atomically in one undoable change.

tools.name: undo_edit
tools.description: Undo this connection’s recent change group in the specified theme. Dependent groups and changes made by other connections are refused.

tools.name: upload_image
tools.description: Upload a JPEG or PNG image to Shopemail’s immutable public image hosting for use in email blocks. Maximum 3 MB and 1600 pixels per side. Requires workspace editor access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: open_editor, list_emails, read_email, list_blocks, get_email_options, list_data_fields, get_editor_formats, list_images, get_preview_data, add_data_field, reorder_blocks, studio_snapshot · Private data: set_brand_logo, set_theme_font, set_theme_token, set_dark_theme_token · Public sink: open_editor, read_email, list_blocks, get_email_options, list_images, preview_email, inspect_email, export_email, set_email_item_layout, set_brand_logo, set_theme_font, set_checklist_item, set_shared_setting, set_theme_setting, set_section_visibility, remove_section, restore_section, set_email_copy, set_email_content, set_email_style, set_email_brand_defaults, set_block_style, set_native_block_visibility, set_section_rule, remove_section_rule, add_data_field, reorder_blocks, set_custom_code, duplicate_block, upload_image · Destructive: get_email_options, get_editor_formats, set_theme_font, set_checklist_item, remove_section, set_email_content, remove_section_rule, remove_block_rule, remove_block_content, remove_data_field, remove_block.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: open_editor, list_emails, read_email, list_blocks, get_email_options, list_data_fields, get_editor_formats, list_images, get_preview_data, add_data_field, reorder_blocks, studio_snapshot · Private data: set_brand_logo, set_theme_font, set_theme_token, set_dark_theme_token · Public sink: open_editor, read_email, list_blocks, get_email_options, list_images, preview_email, inspect_email, export_email, set_email_item_layout, set_brand_logo, set_theme_font, set_checklist_item, set_shared_setting, set_theme_setting, set_section_visibility, remove_section, restore_section, set_email_copy, set_email_content, set_email_style, set_email_brand_defaults, set_block_style, set_native_block_visibility, set_section_rule, remove_section_rule, add_data_field, reorder_blocks, set_custom_code, duplicate_block, upload_image · Destructive: get_email_options, get_editor_formats, set_theme_font, set_checklist_item, remove_section, set_email_content, remove_section_rule, remove_block_rule, remove_block_content, remove_data_field, remove_block

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_data_fields" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List standard notification fields and registered metafield definitions for content or rules. Metafield availability is not verified against Shopify." → after: "List standard notification fields and registered metafield definitions for content or rules. Workspace grants also include Shopify definitions from the latest authorized discovery snapshot. Definition discovery does not prove a value exists when a notification sends."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
